title: Mochizuki Honami — For My Dear Childhood Friends〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Lunch Break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's so warm out today.
Warm enough to actually go outside.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, hanging some laundry or bedding outside today would make it feel so fluffy afterward.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hehe. You're such a mom, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Haha... I couldn't help it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I totally get what you mean, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It'd be great to hang some bedding out to dry and take a nap on it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: While it's drying? How does that work?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Haha.
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh, I should tell Ichika about Ms. Yoisaki before I forget.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika, about the person you asked Asahina to hand that CD to...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?!
You've been doing housework for that person?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I was surprised to find out as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And then...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, Ms. Yoisaki...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would you like to meet my friend...? That is, if you'd like to...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: M-Me meeting her?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Again, you don't have to if don't like...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'd like to thank her for the CD, so would you mind setting us up?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What? You asked her to meet us...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I expected her to turn it down, but she ended up agreeing to it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Honami...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's great, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Especially since you said that you missed your chance to ask Asahina about this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Exactly. Thank you, Honami.
I really don't know what else to say.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, you don't have to thank me like that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I feel a little bad about not telling you about Ms. Yoisaki even though I had known for a while now that she composes her own music...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You would know what since you've been to her house.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, but only for work. I felt that divulging anything personal about her would've been unprofessional.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As a standard rule, yes, so I believe you were doing the right thing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But... At the same time, she might've been able to help Ichika and Saki with their songwriting if I'd asked sooner.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (There was no way for me to help them, but Ms. Yoisaki may've been able to...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Don't fret so much about that, Hona!
I have a feeling that not asking was the right answer, you know?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, if someone else came in to save the day, I probably wouldn't have put as much effort into it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. Knowing that we could ask someone for help might've had the opposite effect...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Exactly! It's our band and our song, so we should be the ones doing all the work♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki, all of you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. You should also make sure to wear an outfit that makes you stand out. You know, to make sure they know it's you♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, their little encounter at the CD shop's the only time they've seen each other, right? What if they don't really remember what you look like?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And if you ever get stuck during a conversation, you could just talk about your outfit.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see... But I'm still not very good at talking to people I'm meeting for the first time. I'm really not sure if I'll be able to make use of your advice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, Honami...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Would you mind joining us, Honami?
I honestly don't have much confidence in keeping a conversation going with her.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Would you mind joining us for this? I honestly don't really get out much, so I may have some trouble keeping a conversation going.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Hehe. They both asked me the same thing.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course. Ms. Yoisaki actually asked me the same thing, so I'll go.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You will?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. So you have nothing to worry about, Ichika. But I do suggest having some questions ready beforehand.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I will! Thank you so much, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're welcome.
